entries.title: Utah Attorney General moves to dismiss the 14 criminal charges against Kalshi without prejudice after the platform blocked Utah users
entries.facts: The Utah Attorney General's Office stated on November 24, 2026 that it filed a motion in Utah's Third District Court to dismiss, without prejudice, the case covering the 14 criminal charges it brought on October 28, 2026 in that court against Kalshi and individual defendants. The office stated that dismissal without prejudice means the office can refile the charges if Kalshi resumes offering its prediction markets, and Attorney General Derek Brown stated that Kalshi has pulled out of Utah and that if it returns, so will the charges. The office stated that Kalshi has blocked Utahns from its prediction market and said it would geofence the state. The announcement reports a motion filed and does not report a ruling by the court.
entries.source_label: Utah Attorney General, office statement, November 24, 2026
entries.relevant_to: prediction-market platforms, event-contract exchanges, sports-wagering operators
